title: Compac ATV R2 (manufacturer SCBC, device R2, Realtek), Android TV 9 (API 28),
header:
Compac ATV R2 (manufacturer SCBC, device R2, Realtek), Android TV 9 (API 28),
firmware PTT1.201001.001, 2 GB RAM. Same SCBC platform as examples/sanyo-atv-r2.

Apply:   TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/disable.sh examples/compac-atv-r2/debloat.txt
Undo:    TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/restore.sh examples/compac-atv-r2/debloat.txt
Everything is DISABLED, not uninstalled. Comment out any line you want to keep.

Stock launcher is com.google.android.tvlauncher. It is not in this list: disable it only once a
replacement Home is installed (launcher/build-and-install.sh does that in the right order).

Notes from this TV:
- Kept in use: Google Assistant (katniss), FastCast Miracast (com.creative.fastscreen.tv),
firmware updates (com.apps.ota, com.apps.authota), Spotify, YouTube Music, Play Movies, Play Games.
- Not touched, unclear: com.apps.esticker (ShowService overlay, likely store-demo stickers) and
io.mimi.tvapp (Mimi hearing-profile sound app, bundles Mixpanel).
- Leave alone, as on the SANYO: com.realtek.tv.* (inputs, tuner), com.apps.smartkey / virtualkey /
bluetoothremote / com.functions.autopair (remote), com.apps.puresound, com.apps.usbmediaplayer.
- The saved Wi-Fi network belongs to android.uid.system, not setupwraith.

apps.note: sponsored and recommendation rows on the stock Home

optional.note: KEEP: supplies the Inputs button on the stock Home

apps.note: Chromecast built-in; re-enable to cast from phones
